# symbolic: a computer-algebra certificate

A certificate is something easy to check that implies the claim, such as a polynomial with nonnegative
coefficients. sympy finds it and the evidence records it, so anyone can re-check it without trusting sympy. It
stays **empirical** until Lean checks the same certificate.

Shared code: `_certificate.py`.
